message.content: Okay, second, the frequency for the reviewers can be quantified rather than guessed. Does the review trigger by line count or commit count? out of the times it triggered, how many times did it find something? we can get an estimate of number of errors per lines of code, and decide what we accept as tolerable. An obvious refinement of this is that not each line of code is equally likely to be wrong, different tasks, files, type of changes may be more prone to errors than others, maybe we have enough data to even quantify that
